en: A vintage black-and-white postcard featuring the ruins of a castle on a wooded hill, a small rural village with traditional houses, a church with a tall spire, and a bridge over a stream in the foreground. The image has an old-fashioned, sepia tone. The bottom of the postcard is labeled with the text 'Burgruine Köhren.' There is also a handwritten red number in the upper right corner.
